question.problem: Let $a=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 2 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$ and $b=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 8 \\ -4 \\ 4\end{aligned}].$ Find the orthogonal projection of $a$ onto $\text{Span}\{b\}.$
question.worked_solution:
The orthogonal projection of $a$ onto $\text{Span}\{b\}$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{b}\,a & =\frac{b\cdot a}{b\cdot b}b \\  & =\frac{4\cdot 3+8\cdot 2+(-4)\cdot 1+4\cdot 1}{{4}^{2}+{8}^{2}+(-4)^{2}+{4}^{2}}b \\  & =\frac{12+16-4+4}{16+64+16+16}b \\  & =\frac{28}{112}b \\  & =\frac{1}{4}b \\  & =\frac{1}{4}[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 8 \\ -4 \\ 4\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 2 \\ -1 \\ 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
